last_mail.subject: [Luran] WhatsApp capacity: connections near the limit
last_mail.body_text: WhatsApp capacity: connections near the limit Luran WhatsApp capacity: connections near the limit The WhatsApp channel is approaching a platform limit. New tenant connections will be refused once it is reached. Live WhatsApp connections: 1 of 2 allowed (50%). Alert threshold: 80% or one connection short of the limit. What to do Check the sidecar host (memory and live sessions) before more tenants connect Raise WHATSAPP_MAX_CONNECTIONS or the sidecar capacity only once the host has room This alert is sent at most once every 6 hours per condition.
